# Toast

A short message that confirms an action and goes away.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** Confirms a place on the waitlist.

- **Use it when:** Saved, sent, exported: something people should notice without stopping.
- **Not when:** A failure people must understand (alert or dialog), or a notice that stays (alert).

Instead:

- [Alert](./alert.md): Stays on the page.
- [Dialog](./dialog.md): Needs an answer.

## Why it works this way

Toast looks the way it does because of 3 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Toast, and what would move if it changed.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

Test before you ship:

- [ ] It is announced politely without taking focus, and stays long enough to read. undefined
- [ ] Nothing people must act on lives only in a toast. undefined

## Component keys

The CSS variable is the key with `/` replaced by `-` and the base `@` dropped. Each key points to a token; values live only on primitives.

| Key | What it controls | Points to, light | Points to, dark |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `overlay/background` | Fill of a dialog, menu or toast. | `color.surface.raised` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.surface.raised` → `color.taupe.light.0` | `color.surface.raised` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.surface.raised` → `color.taupe.dark.100` |
| `overlay/radius` | Corner radius of overlays. | `radius.container` → `brand-expressive.theme.base.radius.container` → `radius.24` | same |
| `overlay/shadow` | Shadow of overlays. | `elevation.overlay` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.elevation.overlay` → `shadow.overlay` | `elevation.overlay` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.elevation.overlay` → `shadow.overlay-dark` |
| `overlay/scrim` | Color that dims the page behind a dialog. | `color.surface.scrim` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.surface.scrim` → `color.black.light.scrim` | `color.surface.scrim` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.surface.scrim` → `color.black.dark.scrim` |
| `overlay/item-height` | Height of a menu item. | `size.control.default` → `size.52` | same |
| `tooltip/background` | Tooltip fill. | `color.surface.inverse` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.surface.inverse` → `color.taupe.light.900` | `color.surface.inverse` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.surface.inverse` → `color.taupe.dark.900` |
| `tooltip/label` | Tooltip text. | `color.text.inverse` → `brand-expressive.theme.light.color.text.inverse` → `color.taupe.light.0` | `color.text.inverse` → `brand-expressive.theme.dark.color.text.inverse` → `color.taupe.dark.50` |
